assessment.nobel_worthiness: Car-Parrinello dynamics unified electronic structure and molecular dynamics, making ab initio simulation of liquids, solids and reactions routine. Original, clear, and a foundation for condensed-phase and biomolecular QM simulation. A natural computational-chemistry prize in the line of 2013 multiscale modelling.
assessment.attribution: Car and Parrinello's 1985 paper is the unambiguous origin and the two-person configuration is clean. Parrinello's other work (metadynamics, ML potentials) is separate and need not be rewarded here.
assessment.maturity: Four decades of validation and broad adoption across chemistry, materials and biophysics. Recognition is, if anything, overdue.
uncertainties: Whether the committee prefers to recognize Parrinello for a broader body of work (metadynamics, ML potentials) than this single method.
Prior recognition of Car and Parrinello by other prizes does not bear on eligibility but may affect urgency.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Pd-catalyzed C-N coupling is a transformative, ubiquitous method in pharmaceutical and materials synthesis, with clear lasting impact. Ranks below the computational choice only on my own field bias; as chemistry it is of very high quality.
assessment.attribution: Buchwald and Hartwig developed the general catalytic amination with the decisive ligand and scope advances; Kosugi's earlier tin-amide coupling is a precursor, and Migita-related priority is an acknowledged wrinkle. Two laureates form a fair configuration.
assessment.maturity: Mature, with 30 years of industrial use. Timing is excellent, although palladium cross-coupling was already recognized in 2010, which may count against it.
uncertainties: Credit relative to Kosugi's earlier work and to the 2010 cross-coupling prize.
I have not independently verified detailed priority chronology.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Genetic code expansion with orthogonal tRNA/synthetase pairs lets site-specific incorporation of noncanonical amino acids in living cells, a fundamental tool for protein chemistry and engineering, and for enzyme mechanism studies.
assessment.attribution: Schultz established the approach; Chin extended it to multicellular organisms, multiple codons and engineered ribosomes; Wang was a key early contributor. Yokoyama and Mehl contributions are real, so the three-name configuration leaves some credit unresolved.
assessment.maturity: Over two decades of confirmation and wide use. Timely, and it fits the recent biomolecular-tool trend (2018, 2020, 2024).
uncertainties: Allocation of credit among Schultz, Chin and Wang.
Therapeutic payoffs remain modest, though the tool value is clear.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Induced-proximity degradation is a new chemical mode of action, with PROTACs and molecular glues now in clinical trials and a mechanistic shift in drug discovery; ligand-binding and ternary-complex energetics are of direct interest to me.
assessment.attribution: Crews and Deshaies developed the PROTAC concept, with Ciulli providing the VHL ligand and structural basis. The Handa/Ito thalidomide-cereblon discovery is also decisive for glues, so attribution is complex and a compound discovery may need distinct recognition.
assessment.maturity: Strong evidence of concept and many clinical programs, but no approved PROTAC drug yet, so possibly early.
uncertainties: Whether the clinical outcome is mature enough.
Split between PROTACs and molecular glues; the cereblon story could support a separate prize.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Base editing is a chemically conceived way to rewrite single nucleotides, with enormous research and therapeutic impact; a clear chemistry-driven invention following the 2020 CRISPR prize.
assessment.attribution: Liu's group made the decisive conceptual and experimental contributions, with Komor and Gaudelli as lead authors on cytosine and adenine editors. Nishida and Kondo made parallel contributions to cytidine deamination editing.
assessment.maturity: Rapid adoption and first clinical results are encouraging, but long-term safety evidence is still accumulating.
uncertainties: Overlap with prime editing (B062) and with the Medicine and Chemistry prior CRISPR recognition.
Whether the committee views this as chemistry rather than biology.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The funnel energy landscape view resolved the Levinthal paradox and unified protein folding theory; deeply relevant to my own field of biomolecular free-energy simulation. Conceptually major and long-lasting.
assessment.attribution: Wolynes and Onuchic are central to the funnel and minimal frustration theory; Dill's hydrophobic and lattice models were influential; Bryngelson and Fersht have strong claims, so any three-person subset leaves tension.
assessment.maturity: Well-established and confirmed by simulation and experiment over decades, so timely in the sense of being mature.
uncertainties: Difficult credit allocation among theorists and experimentalists.
The 2024 prize on protein structure prediction may reduce urgency for another protein topic.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The dye-sensitized mesoscopic solar cell opened a field of photoelectrochemical energy conversion, an original and widely recognized invention that preceded perovskite cells.
assessment.attribution: The 1991 O'Regan-Grätzel Nature paper is the foundational report; Hagfeldt contributed significantly to later understanding and development. Two-person award is clean.
assessment.maturity: Mature, over 30 years, though practical efficiency has lagged and the field has moved to perovskites.
uncertainties: Whether O'Regan's role is judged decisive.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Native mass spectrometry allows study of intact noncovalent assemblies, ribosomes, proteasomes and membrane protein complexes, linking chemistry to structural biology; I find it interesting for ribosome-relevant work.
assessment.attribution: Robinson, Heck and Chait made distinct pioneering and technical contributions; Loo and Gross also have claims, and the 2002 prize already covered ESI, so the credit is crowded.
assessment.maturity: Mature and broadly used, but some of the field's lineage was already recognized.
uncertainties: Crowded attribution and partial overlap with the 2002 ESI/MALDI prize.
I have not verified the precise priority among the early groups.
